howToPlay: Control the battlefield by forcing projectiles through obstacles using your Super. Utilize the Gadget Ragequit to defend yourself against encroaching enemies or create defensive dice towers with Mansions Of Meeple to zone out opponents.
gears: Equip SPEED to navigate the map effectively and DAMAGE to boost your offensive pressure when at low health.
trait: This brawler suits tactical players who enjoy manipulating map terrain and controlling enemy movement through strategic positioning.
